# `m.partners.etf_global.profiles`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

ETF Global's profiles of US ETFs: issuer, fees, assets, trading, and exposures.

```python
m.partners.etf_global.profiles(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol`, `EffectiveDate` and `ProcessedDate` (`dm.PollMode.REPLACE`) |
| `sort` | any REST field of the rows (see Massive fields below), or several separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc` |
| `filters` | `composite_ticker_gt`, `composite_ticker_gte`, `composite_ticker_lt`, `composite_ticker_lte`, `effective_date`, `effective_date_gt`, `effective_date_gte`, `effective_date_lt`, `effective_date_lte`, `processed_date`, `processed_date_gt`, `processed_date_gte`, `processed_date_lt`, `processed_date_lte` |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | ETF Profiles & Exposure (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| ETF Global Profiles & Exposure | Updated daily, All history |
| ETF Global Profiles & Exposure Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `composite_ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol used to identify this ETF product on exchanges." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `Administrator` | String | The administrator of the ETF. | REST |
| `Advisor` | String | The investment advisor of the ETF. | REST |
| `AssetClass` | String | The primary type of assets held by the ETF, such as equities, bonds, commodities, or other securities. | REST |
| `Aum` | double | The total assets under management, representing the current market value of all assets held by the ETF. | REST |
| `AvgDailyTradingVolume` | double | The average number of shares traded daily over the past month, indicating liquidity and investor interest. | REST |
| `BidAskSpread` | double | The average intraday bid-ask spread as a percentage, calculated by dividing the spread by the lowest ask price sampled during the day. | REST |
| `CallVolume` | double | Call options volume. | REST |
| `Category` | String | The broad investment category that describes the ETF's investment focus and strategy. | REST |
| `CouponExposure` | String | Coupon exposure breakdown for fixed income ETFs. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `CreationFee` | double | The fee for creating new shares of the ETF. | REST |
| `CreationUnitSize` | double | The size of creation units for the ETF. | REST |
| `CurrencyExposure` | String | Currency exposure breakdown of the ETF. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `Custodian` | String | The custodian of the ETF assets. | REST |
| `Description` | String | The official name and description of the ETF product. | REST |
| `DevelopmentClass` | String | The economic development classification of the markets the ETF invests in, such as developed, emerging, or frontier markets. | REST |
| `DiscountPremium` | double | Discount or premium to net asset value. | REST |
| `DistributionFrequency` | String | How frequently the ETF makes distributions. | REST |
| `Distributor` | String | The distributor of the ETF. | REST |
| `EffectiveDate` | String | The date showing when the information was accurate or valid; some issuers, such as Vanguard, release their data on a delay, so the effective_date can be several weeks earlier than the processed_date. | REST |
| `FeeWaivers` | double | Any fee waivers applied to the ETF. | REST |
| `FiscalYearEnd` | String | The fiscal year end date for the ETF. | REST |
| `Focus` | String | The specific investment focus or exposure that the ETF provides, such as sector, geography, or investment style. | REST |
| `FuturesCommissionMerchant` | String | The futures commission merchant, if applicable. | REST |
| `GeographicExposure` | String | Geographic exposure breakdown of the ETF. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `InceptionDate` | String | The date when this ETF was first launched and became available for trading. | REST |
| `IndustryExposure` | String | Industry exposure breakdown of the ETF. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `IndustryGroupExposure` | String | Industry group exposure breakdown of the ETF. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `Issuer` | String | The financial institution or fund company that created and sponsors this ETF. | REST |
| `LeadMarketMaker` | String | The lead market maker for the ETF. | REST |
| `LeverageStyle` | String | Indicates whether the ETF uses leverage to amplify returns ('leveraged'), or does not use leverage ('unleveraged'). | REST |
| `LeveredAmount` | double | The leverage multiplier applied by the ETF, where positive numbers indicate leveraged exposure and negative numbers indicate inverse exposure. | REST |
| `ListingExchange` | String | The primary exchange where the ETF is listed. | REST |
| `ManagementClassification` | String | Defines whether an ETF is considered active under SEC rules, with managers making investment decisions, or passive, tracking an index. | REST |
| `ManagementFee` | double | The annual fee charged by the fund manager for managing the ETF's portfolio and operations. | REST |
| `MaturityExposure` | String | Maturity exposure breakdown for fixed income ETFs. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `NetExpenses` | double | Net expenses after waivers. | REST |
| `NumHoldings` | double | Number of holdings in the ETF. | REST |
| `OptionsAvailable` | long | Availability of options on the ETF. | REST |
| `OptionsVolume` | double | Options trading volume for the ETF. | REST |
| `OtherExpenses` | double | Other expenses charged by the ETF. | REST |
| `PortfolioManager` | String | The portfolio manager of the ETF. | REST |
| `PrimaryBenchmark` | String | The main index or benchmark that this ETF is designed to track or replicate. | REST |
| `ProcessedDate` | String | The date showing when ETF Global received and processed the data. | REST |
| `ProductType` | String | Indicates whether the product is an Exchange-Traded Note ('etn') or an Exchange-Traded Fund ('etf'). | REST |
| `PutCallRatio` | double | Put/call ratio for options on the ETF. | REST |
| `PutVolume` | double | Put options volume. | REST |
| `Region` | String | The geographic region or area of the world where the ETF concentrates its investments. | REST |
| `SectorExposure` | String | Sector exposure breakdown of the ETF. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `ShortInterest` | double | Short interest in the ETF. | REST |
| `Subadvisor` | String | The subadvisor of the ETF, if applicable. | REST |
| `SubindustryExposure` | String | Sub-industry exposure breakdown of the ETF. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `TaxClassification` | String | The tax structure of the ETF, determining whether investors receive 1099 or K1 tax forms (RIC, Partnership, or UIT). | REST |
| `TotalExpenses` | double | The total annual expense ratio of the ETF, including all fees and costs passed on to investors. | REST |
| `TransferAgent` | String | The transfer agent for the ETF. | REST |
| `Trustee` | String | The trustee of the ETF. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |

`RawSymbol` holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. A session with `unreadable_symbols=dm.OnError.RAISE` (or `DEEPHAVEN_MASSIVE_UNREADABLE_SYMBOLS=raise`) fails on such a row instead and has no `RawSymbol`; the table shows the default session.
